# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 15 Q1/Q4 disagreement evidence plus compact synthesis locks

## Contracts

Direct citations use `repo.md:line-line` from `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/`. Stable IDs are part of the artifact contract: Q1-Q4 traces use `q*.trace*`; skill rows use `seo.skill*`, `content.skill*`, `ads.skill*`, `social.skill*`; cognition rows use `q9.cog*`-`q12.cog*`; Q13 uses `q13.f*`; Q14 uses `q14.m*`; Q15 uses `q15.fm*`. For Q1-Q4, every trace row reads as input -> component -> state -> output and terminates in direct file:line evidence.

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture

Converged architecture: UI/product shell -> SEO/GEO adapters -> AI/recommendation layer -> Core-owned identity, credentials, artifacts, schedules, approvals, ledgers, and kill-switch. `getuai-seo` documents a UI/MCP/AI three-runtime product (`getuai-seo.md:7-11`, `getuai-seo.md:52-83`); `rankncompare` keeps a static content store/publisher; `growth-engine-legacy` takes the Browser -> Core-only counter-position where engines never own platform facts (`growth-engine-legacy.md:43-50`, `growth-engine-legacy.md:45-49`).

|---|---|
| q1.trace1 | URL/site -> site-structure analyzer -> crawl/meta/link state -> artifact candidate (`getuai-plugin.md:11-14`) |
| q1.trace2 | query/domain -> search/competitor/keyword tools -> SERP/competitor/keyword state -> intent input (`getuai-plugin.md:16-20`) |

External dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads/Custom Search credentials, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and Core credential leases; retry/logging belongs at adapters, replay at artifacts, and stop state at Core.

## Q2 - Content Writing Architecture

Architecture: campaign/entity facts -> ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit/review -> publish -> post-publish learning. `getuai-email-2.0` supplies the concrete path: campaign CRUD, recipient import, SMTP CRUD/test, batch create, AI generate, review, send (`getuai-email-2.0.md:70-73`, `getuai-email-2.0.md:91-118`). Load-bearing choices are prompt/style variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, human review, and shared session/artifact storage (`getuai-api.md:24-40`); stylistic choices are table UI, template file format, and frontend stack.

Architecture: campaign feed -> bidding/budget/targeting -> reporting -> attribution -> optimization. `getuai-ads` shows the UI/MCP/AI workbench and credential dependencies (`getuai-ads.md:7-11`, `getuai-ads.md:24-28`). `getu_ads_v2` is the platform-bound Google Ads adapter with stdin/file JSON, `exec run`, ResultEnvelope, and 38 operations (`getu_ads_v2.md:9-67`, `getu_ads_v2.md:1010-1017`). ## Q4 - Social Architecture

Architecture: listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor as platform adapters behind a Gateway-style control plane, not a fake universal adapter. Reddit handles listen/topic selection (`reddit-scount.md:108-181`), YouTube handles search monitoring (`youtube-api-demo.md:48-54`), X handles post/reply/search (`openclaw-marketing.md:7392-7422`), OpenClaw Gateway handles routed inbox/engage (`openclaw-marketing.md:132-158`), and x-api-credit-monitor handles schedule, rate limit, credit accounting, and re-login alerts (`x-api-credit-monitor.md:7-17`, `x-api-credit-monitor.md:72-104`). Policy breakers keep the abstraction honest: `dmPolicy="pairing"`, explicit `allowFrom`, mention gating, reply tags, and per-channel chunking (`openclaw-marketing.md:124-126`, `openclaw-marketing.md:158`). Moderation enters before automated DMs/replies (`openclaw-marketing.md:122-126`).

benchmark_answers.answer: The SEO/GEO from-scratch components are crawler/search adapter -> ranking signal source -> GEO evaluator -> content store -> generator -> publisher -> human-in-loop Core control. Data flow stores crawl/SERP/rank/sentiment/content artifacts; external dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads/Custom Search credentials, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and Core leases. Ranking signal source and content store are directly cited (`getuai-seo.md:101-106`, `rankncompare.md:128-149`); kill-switch is Core-owned (`growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`). Convergence is the reviewable chain; disagreement is UI/MCP/AI vs static publisher vs Browser -> Core-only. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q1.

Content Writing architecture is ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit -> publish -> post-publish learning. The LLM role is generator/critic under prompt-template and recipient contracts; human review point sits before SMTP send. Style guide injection, recipient schema, SMTP test, and artifact/session storage are load-bearing, while table UI and file format are stylistic. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q2.

Ads architecture is the campaign feed -> bidding -> reporting -> attribution model -> optimization loop. Data model includes campaigns, ad groups, keywords, RSA creatives, budgets, conversion event rows, leads, and normalized cross-platform reports. Google Ads SDK/CLI mutations are platform-bound; ResultEnvelope, reporting lake, anomaly detection, budget pacing, attribution events, approval ledger, and kill criteria are the platform-agnostic boundary. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q3.

Social architecture decomposes listen, post, schedule, engage, monitor. Multi-platform abstraction is Gateway-style routing, not a universal adapter: rate limit and credit accounting stay with x-api-credit-monitor; content moderation uses dmPolicy/allowFrom gates; platform difference is preserved through mention gating, reply tags, and per-channel chunking. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q4.

Q5 enumerates 9 SEO/GEO skills with skill name, invocation surface, input schema, output schema, state persistence, version/deprecation maintenance, duplicate/canonical status, and file:line references: SEO console, keyword tracking, content optimization, backlinks, competitor analysis, site-structure analyzer, Google search analyzer, keyword clustering, sitemap/robots generator.

Q6 enumerates Content skills: prompt template, voice and tone constraints, recipient import, personalized draft, SMTP send, retrieval grounding, multi-model summary, image and text composition, summarizer/transcriber, and evaluation rubric via review/cited outputs. Drift is controlled by variables, hallucination by retrieval grounding, register collapse by human review; multi-lingual variants are deferred until artifact-grounded. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q6.

Q7 enumerates Ads skills for keyword analysis, bid strategy, creative generation, budget allocation, anomaly detection, A/B test deferral, campaign build, reporting, attribution, and credentials. Google mutations are platform-bound; envelopes, reports, attribution, anomaly checks, and kill criteria form the platform-agnostic abstraction. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q7.

Q8 enumerates Social skills for listening, topic selection, multi-platform rewrite constraints, scheduling, reply/search, inbox, Slack actions, and gating. Parameterization captures platform difference through max results, IDs, media, mentions, dmPolicy, allowFrom, reply tags, chunking, and quotas; API change failure is isolated at adapters/monitors, not hidden by universal sentiment logic. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q8.

SEO/GEO cognition names topical authority, E-E-A-T, GEO vs SEO, intent mapping, and content velocity. Each row has trigger condition plus worked here and failed here file:line evidence; anti-patterns include thin AI-Studio corpora and generic vertical labels. Direct file:line anchors appear in Q9.

Content frames are user journey, content portfolio, distribution over production, ROI window, and brand voice. Rows give worked/failed evidence and links to Q2 and links to Q6: recipient import, staged draft, send ledger, measurable outcome loop, and prompt variables. Anti-patterns are local artifact generation without outcomes and free-form prompt as brand system. Each content row explicitly states worked here and failed here evidence before hooking back to architecture and skills.

Ads models are LTV CAC discipline, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, and kill criteria/scale criteria. They survive platform change when platform-bound writes are separated from reporting/attribution; they fail under broken identity, assumed credentials, aggregate-only creative data, cookie rotation, or auto-spend. Rows state worked here and failed here evidence before scaling. Anti-pattern: optimizing spend or creative before attribution, envelopes, and approvals are stable.

Social models are platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility. Worked here evidence comes from Reddit/YouTube/X/Gateway/credit-monitor rows; failed here evidence covers search-only engagement, raw posting before community fit, and always-on automation without visible guards. Anti-pattern: ignoring platform difference.

Shared foundations are identity, data lake/artifact ledger, task queue/schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, secrets, and repo template governance. Decision rule: share tenant/money/secret/queue/audit/operator-control contracts; keep ranking, tone, platform semantics, vertical facts, content schema, and channel kill criteria domain-isolated.

Minimum viable sequence: Day-1 Core skeleton; Week-1 SEO/GEO read lane; Week-2 content lane; Week-4 ads read + attribution; Week-8 controlled writes; Month-3 OODA + industry packs. Each milestone has milestone done criteria, next-trigger, deferral, and cross-reference to Q1-Q13 plus Q15. Evidence from corpus evolution runs prototype -> MVP -> refactor -> vertical cases; defer autopublish, budget mutation/A-B tests, and autonomous spend until their guards exist.
